content_sections.heading: About MGU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Mahatma Gandhi University, established by the Kerala State Legislature under Notification No. 3431/Leg. C1/85/Law dated 17th April 1985, is situated at Priyadarshini Hills P.O., Kottayam, Kerala - 686 560. For enquiries, candidates may contact 0481 - 2731020, 2733300 or Registrar: 0481 - 2731007, or email [email protected] / [email protected] (website: www.mgu.ac.in). The present recruitment is conducted under Re-Notification 3 for temporary teaching positions across university centres and schools for the 2026–2027 academic session.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: A total of 3 contract vacancies have been notified across university centres and schools. * In the absence of applicants from the specified reservation category, applicants belonging to other reserved categories will be considered. In the absence of applicants belonging to other reserved categories, applicants from the Open Competition category (OC) will be considered. ** In the absence of applicants from the specific differently-abled category, applicants from other differently-abled categories will be considered; in their absence, applicants from other reserved categories will be considered; and in the absence of those as well, applicants from the OC category will be considered. Abbreviations: LC/AI - Latin Catholic / Anglo Indian, PH - Differently Abled, V - Viswakarma, EWS - Economically Weaker Section, OC - Open Competition.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Candidates who obtained Degree/Ph.D. from Universities/Institutions outside the State of Keralam shall submit an equivalency/eligibility certificate obtained from Mahatma Gandhi University. Refer to the official notification for discipline-specific eligibility of each post. As per the UGC Regulations regarding the appointment of Assistant Professors. Teachers who retired from Colleges/ Universities will also be considered subject to the condition that the maximum age limit shall be 70 years as on 01.01.2026.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The engagement carries a consolidated pay of ₹40,000/- per month. The appointment is purely on a contract basis for the academic year 2026–2027 (till April 15, 2027). The selected candidates shall execute an agreement with the University as per the existing norms.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MGU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in the application proforma attached to the official notification with all required personal, educational, teaching, and research details. Compile scanned copies of all supporting original certificates and documents into digital format. Send the completed proforma and scanned documents via email to [email protected] within 10 days from the date of the notification (about 24 October 2026).

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Duly filled proforma attached with the notification Proof of age Proof of community reservation (Community Certificate and Non-Creamy Layer Certificate issued by the authorities concerned) Differently Abled Category / EWS certificate (as per State Govt. Criteria) issued by the Competent Authority, if applicable Qualifications proof (Mark lists and Degree Certificates) Proof that journals are approved by UGC / peer-reviewed Impact factor documentation of published articles Experience certificate Awards certificates Proof for CGPA to percentage conversion Proof of all other additional qualifications Equivalency/eligibility certificate from Mahatma Gandhi University (for candidates with Degree/Ph.D. from institutions outside the State of Keralam)

content_sections.heading: MGU Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Natives of States other than Keralam need not apply for the post notified exclusively under the community reservation quota. In the case of teaching experience in guest/contract/temporary positions, service shall be counted only after acquiring minimum qualifications stipulated by the UGC for the post of assistant professor. Late applications and the applications that are not submitted in the prescribed format or without the scanned copies of certificates to prove age, community, creamy layer status, educational qualification, experience, CGPA to percentage conversion, impact factor of the published articles, equivalency/ eligibility will summarily be rejected.

rows.details: MGU Assistant Professor Re-Notification 3 and Proforma

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in MGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 contract vacancies for Assistant Professor posts across Hindi, Microbiology/Biotechnology, and Environmental Science.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for MGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent by email within 10 days from the date of the notification (about 24 October 2026).

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Qualifications are as per UGC norms for the appointment of Assistant Professors.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Age is as per UGC Regulations, while retired teachers from Colleges or Universities can apply up to a maximum age limit of 70 years as on 01.01.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly salary for the Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Appointed candidates will receive a consolidated pay of ₹40,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How should candidates submit their application?
faq.answer: Candidates must send the duly filled proforma along with scanned copies of original documents by email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. Is the MGU Assistant Professor post permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The engagement is purely on a contract basis for the current academic year 2026–2027 until 15 April 2027.

faq.question: Q8. Can retired teachers apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Yes, teachers who retired from Colleges or Universities will be considered subject to a maximum age limit of 70 years as on 01.01.2026.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from outside Kerala apply for posts under community reservation?
faq.answer: No, natives of States other than Keralam need not apply for the post notified exclusively under the community reservation quota.

faq.question: Q10. Are degrees obtained outside Kerala accepted?
faq.answer: Yes, but candidates who obtained their Degree or Ph.D. from outside Keralam must submit an equivalency or eligibility certificate from Mahatma Gandhi University.
